baseline.label: phase25-apps-r3
baseline.productionDelta: Only public_client_identifier helper addition and auth_client_projection public clientId equality replacement; no other production source delta in remote_admin.rs.

clientIdentifierReview: Public clientId accepts nonempty 1..100 Unicode characters with no control characters, preserving UUID defaults, independent RP/MACHINE values, Unicode and surrounding spaces.
Internal record.id still requires UUIDv7, and detail/update record.id stays bound to the internal route UUID.
Credential and consent-group operation clientId fields retain their distinct internal UUID meaning and validation.
Exact response-field policy, secret exclusion, whole-page malformed-row rejection and fine permission checks remain in the unchanged production paths.
Unit regression covers valid public identifiers, non-string/empty/overlong/control negatives and malformed/mismatched internal identifiers.

PG regression exercises real canonical rows and production PlatformBoundary/decoder through an explicitly injected metadata transport, including VIEW withdrawal before dispatch and no read mutation intent. This is component evidence, not actual identity HTTP/browser evidence.

registryHelperChecks.method: Extracted the exact registryObservation function from the bound source and evaluated it with node:vm; no module execution or external services.
registryHelperChecks.outputs: Only fixed error-code allowlist, bounded numeric pagination/counts, fixed body kind and distinct-public-ID count. No raw response text or identifiers are copied.

limitations: Rust/PG actual test and Clippy commands are owned and separately reported by runtime_matrix_plan; this review did not rerun them.
New diagnostic helper was not executed during historical r4; diagnosis-time source hashes must not be read as r4 runner inputs.
No new SaaS HTTPS or all-group PASS is claimed. A fresh full apps candidate and tools-equivalent source run remain required.
